dedupe_keys.name: gares et stations du reseau ferre schematique d ile de france petit format

description: Gares et stations du réseau ferré schématique d'Île-de-France (petit format) is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche schématique décrivant, par ligne, les gares de Train, de RER et de Val (mais pas les stations de métro, de tramways, de funiculaire) ouvertes aux voyageurs en Île-de-France. La représentation schématique des objets est adaptée à une utilisation "petit format" pour une petite échelle. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Réseau ferré, Plan régional, Transport, Transports en commun, RER, Tramway. The portal shows 554 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-03-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
